mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies near Fireman's Park with temperatures sitting at 33 degrees and a wind chill of 23 degrees. There is an International Space Station pass tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City offices and the Recycling Center will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, delaying Thursday trash collection to Friday. Additionally, the city is planning a new Public Works facility to better accommodate Verona's population growth.
You can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, enjoy local trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's.
On Tuesday, November 4, Verona officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue, where a Fitchburg woman was arrested for O W I with a minor passenger.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM today, serving up Butter Pecan as the flavor of the day.
